name: Fatal Fury Special
summary:
Fatal Fury Special, known as Garou Densetsu Special (餓狼伝説ＳＰＥＣＩＡＬ) in Japan, is an improved version of the one-on-one fighting game Fatal Fury 2. It was originally released on the Neo Geo by SNK, then it was ported to the Sega Game Gear by Gai Brain and Aspect in 1994.
It has simplified controls and omits several characters, but it retains all of the special moves of the remaining characters. Fights take place on a single lane and lack the lane-switching of the original game.
